title: Sporefall
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Sporefall and the helm marks Blight Moon. Do: Close on Blight Moon. Blight weather eats a harvest drone that parks in it. The wardens patrol and will burn a bad hold. Finish: come inside Blight Moon's shell. The Choir writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
